messages.author: c5d55b0fc9f27a05
messages.subject: dplyr::summarize issue
parts:
Hi,

I encountered something weird about dplyr::summarize:

> mtcars %>% summarize(a1=mean(wt)/sd(wt), b1=mean(mpg)/sd(mpg))
        a1 b1
1 3.288084 NA

However if I tried to change the variable name, sometimes it seems to work, and it feels random if a variable name is good or not. Could you guys reproduce this? I wonder if there's something wrong with my installation. Thanks!


> mtcars %>% summarize(ax=mean(wt)/sd(wt), b1=mean(mpg)/sd(mpg))
        ax       b1
1 3.288084 3.333466
